_: POINT-IN-TIME macro vintages for Egypt: what was KNOWN at each year-end, for the valuation calibration [R-VCAL-01] to rebuild a fair value at that origin. NOT the forward path in engine/macro_paths/EG.json, which is what the house believes today. A rebuild that reaches for today's numbers is not a rebuild; it is the answer wearing a date.
target_span: 2013-2023 year-ends, the span the pre-registration of 03-Sep-2026 fixes
rule: A VINTAGE IS SOURCED OR IT DOES NOT EXIST. Four fields on every figure — value, source, date, tier. No interpolation between years, no carrying a neighbouring year forward, no 'approximately'. An origin whose figures are not all sourced is DROPPED by the calibration and its window shortened, which the pre-registration fixes in advance precisely so that a thin archive shows up as fewer origins rather than as a fuller-looking record built on filled-in cells.
status: ASSEMBLY NOT STARTED. This file is the schema and the rule, committed before any figure, so that every figure added later arrives under a standard rather than setting one. Origins are added ONE AT A TIME as their four figures are read off their own documents — CBE monetary policy statements and the treasury auction record for the policy rate and the sovereign yield, CAPMAS or the CBE bulletin for the CPI print, and the Damodaran country-premium vintage of that year for the equity risk premium. Read engine/macro_history.py report() for what is usable, never this note.
